questions.question: Three of the following four numbers are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the number that is different from the rest.

Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different.

Pick the odd one out.

Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(11, 13, 288)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

(11, 13, 288) → 11 + 13 = 24; 24² = 576 and 576 ÷ 2 = 288

Similarly,

(7, 11, 162) → 7 + 11 = 18; 182 = 324 and 324 ÷ 2 = 162

Hence, the correct answer is (7, 11, 162).

questions.question:
Twenty teams take part in a football tournament. Each team has to play every other team.

How many games would be played in the tournament?
questions.solution:
20 teams are there. Here each team will get 19 matches.

Consider this 19 = n

So, n (n + 1)/2 is the total number of matches played.

Therefore total number of matches = 19(19 + 1)/2 = 190;

Hence, the correct answer is 190.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(11, 13, 17)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

__
 
• 11, 13, and 17 are ***consecutive prime numbers***.
 
• Similarly, 19, 23, and 29 are ***consecutive prime numbers***.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is (19, 23, 29).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Option 1 - 9 is not prime.
 
• Option 2 - The next prime number after 37 is 41.
 
• Option 3 - The next prime number after 31 is 37.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **Alternate Method__** The pattern followed here is:

 
• (11, 13, 17) → 11 + 2 = 13 and 13 + 4 = 17; 4 - 2 = 2
 
• Similarly, (19, 23, 29) → 19 + 4 = 23 and 23 + 6 = 29; 6 - 4 = 2
 
• Hence, the correct answer is (19, 23, 29).

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

68 : 100 :: 45 : _____
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

68 → 6² = 36 and 8² = 64;

Then, 36 + 64 = 100.

Similarly,

45 → 4² = 16 and 5² = 25;

Then, 16 + 25 = 41.

Hence, the related number is 41.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some tractors are boats.

All cups are boats.

All jars are tractors.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tractors are cups.

II. No jar is boat.

III. Some cups are jars.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aca229d06d02de691341b55fc896ab8aa122b69c279ff90577780e012e086a52.png] 

**Explanation:**

I. Some tractors are cups → False (it is possible but not definite)

II. No jar is boat → False (it is possible but not definite)

III. Some cups are jars → False (it is possible but not definite)

Hence, none of the conclusions follows.

questions.question:
Two different position of the same dice are shown. Which number will be at the top if 2 is at the bottom?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fde56d655e843679c4c9ad4573d15467f22ca3764d71595c01c6de67f8e24181.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/860568bdfb3c4c18650d53bc0e3c49cff37c06259959d122ec6163a652dcbd06.png]
questions.solution:
3 is common to both the positions of the given dice.

6 and 4 are adjacent to 3 in the first position.

5 and 2 are adjacent to 3 in the second position.

Thus, the only remaining number 1 must be on the face opposite to that of 3.

This means 5, 3 and 1 are adjacent to 2.

We have 2 choices: either 6 is opposite to 2 or 4 is opposite to 2.

Now, if on rotating the first position such that 3 is on the front face, the initial position of 3 gets replaced by 2 such that 4 is opposite to 2.

We will end up with the following situation:

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ed985445ee63a51446517938c17e35b8f594cc54db747d08838e78a587f362c.png] **

This is not possible as if 2 faces of the given positions are the same, then the third one should also be the same.

Therefore, 4 is not on the face opposite to 2.

So, the opposite face of 2 is 6.

Hence, 6 will be at the top if 2 is at the bottom.
